# Synthetic Garanti BBVA Bonus statements

Generated by `tools/synth_garanti.py` (fixed seed, byte-identical on every run). Nothing here comes
from a real statement: merchants, amounts, the holder `ORNEK KISI`, the address, the customer number
and the card `5400 61** **** 1111` are invented. Only the line structure of `kalan.pdf.extract_text()`
follows the real layout.

Each `gb-NN-<cut-off>.pdf` has a `gb-NN-<cut-off>.json` with the ground truth: statement fields, the
printed summary (`interest_and_fees` included; `remaining_installments` is not printed), every
transaction (installment plans named by `plan_key`), the expected reconciliation checks and buckets,
and the plans still running after that statement. The ground truth comes from the generator's own
simulation of the account, not from the parser.

Plans: P1 `ORNEK ELEKTRONIK AVM` 6x from gb-04; P2 and P4 `DENEME MOBILYA` 3x each from gb-09 (same
shop, same day, different totals); P3 `ORNEK SPOR MAGAZASI` 4x from gb-11.

| File | Scenarios |
|------|-----------|
| gb-01 | first statement: no opening balance row, no cut-off sentence |
| gb-02 | regular month |
| gb-03 | zero balance |
| gb-04 | installment P1 starts, foreign currency row |
| gb-05 | partial payment |
| gb-06 | interest with BSMV / KKDF, long table over a page break |
| gb-07 | bonus spent row |
| gb-08 | foreign currency, foreign merchant charged in TL |
| gb-09 | last installment of P1; P2 and P4 start; refund; annual fee; table over a page break |
| gb-10 | virtual card section |
| gb-11 | last installments of P2 and P4; P3 starts; foreign refund; table over a page break |
| gb-12 | long table over a page break; P3 continues beyond the last statement |

The text layer copies the real one's quirks: the cells of a row share one baseline, the description
cell is padded with real space characters that run past the amount column, sector titles start with
a run of spaces and one filler line holds spaces only. A reader that lets those spaces join the next
cell onto the description line fails on every file here.

Table rows sit under section and sector titles, credits carry a trailing sign (`1.234,56+`), and the
bonus cell comes before the amount; the parser reads them through the `_read_rows` hook.

The embedded font is a subset of Noto Sans (SIL Open Font License 1.1) from `pymupdf-fonts`.
Regenerate with `python tools/synth_garanti.py`.
